description: CR 603.10 the control: the Draught strips the PIKER and both gains reach the Pridemate
note: Synthetic Humbling Draught gains 2 life, strips target creature's abilities until end of turn, then gains 3, all in one resolution. Aimed at the Goblin Piker, the Pridemate keeps its ability for both gains and takes a counter for each; this is the plumbing control for the twin that aims at the Pridemate and must leave it one counter.
